text:
hana: Heads-up from AtlasCloud QA: their marketplace images intermittently fail our runtime on certain host kernels. Failing path looks like missing signed module symbols (mixed kmod builds). Can we coordinate a split-delivery approach?
kevin: what do you mean by split-delivery?
hana: supply two artifacts in the bundle: 1) vendor-signed kernel modules and driver debs for air-gapped installs, 2) an apt/ckan floating repo for cloud images that prefer distro-managed packages. That way SI customers get pinned, partners get flexible updates.
sylvie: liking that. For signed modules we should include module build-ids and GPG signatures in the manifest. Example manifest fields: 
module_build_id: "amdgpu-5d3f3c"
module_signature: "sha256:..."
recommended_kernel: "5.15.0-101 or 6.1.9"
dar: operationally we'll need a clear rollback lane. If partner GA hits issues, runtime should auto-fallback to hosted inference and mark tenant for follow-up. Also add a short smoke script for partners to run pre-GA.
marketplace-team: AtlasCloud asked for a 36h freeze on announcement while we validate. Can we meet that?
eke: I can own the smoke run and upload logs to atlas-partner/bundles/splits/; will run on 10% of hosts.
hana: please include ROCm and CUDA checks. If module load fails, collect /proc/modules, dmesg tail, and core dumps.
sylvie: SI packaging note: for air-gapped copies provide a checksums.txt, signed manifest, and a README with install order: kernel headers -> signed modules -> driver deb -> runtime. Call out NOT to install distro meta packages.
dar: telemetry add: driver_bundle=atlas-split and driver_status=verified|mismatch in startup events so we can correlate field errors.
si-ops-bot: ticket ATLAS-512 created: split-delivery-driver-artifacts.
hana: action list:
- kevin: prepare signed debs & module tar (due 4387655000)
- eke: run canary + smoke (due 4387655200)
- sylvie: publish manifest + README (due 4387654800)
- marketplace-team: pause GA for 36h (pending)

kevin: :thumbsup:
sylvie: :thumbsup:
hana: thanks all, will post status updates here when each artifact is uploaded.
